name: Higher Resolution Vehicle Pack
description: Higher resolution textures for every vehicle in the game, inside and out, including the dirt and the graffiti. Covers GTA IV and both episodes. By Ash735, 15th Anniversary Edition.

sources.note: Has to be supplied by hand: published only on https://www.nexusmods.com/gta4/mods/282, and Nexus hands out links that expire with a session. Take the file called 'Complete Edition Vehicle Pack' and drop it into the working directory exactly as it comes - the name above is the one Nexus gives version 2.4.
